description: HadCM3B-ESM comprises dynamic modelling of the atmosphere (hadam3), sulphate aerosols (hadcm3-aerosol), land surface (moses2-1), ocean (hadom3), ocean sea-ice (hadcm3-sea-ice) and ocean biogeochemistry (hadocc)  land ice is prescribed (land points identified as land ice are completely covered in ice and fixed in time). Non-ice points can have fractional covering of vegetation types or non-vegetation (urban, lake)  atmospheric chemistry is ommitted other than use of prescribed oxidants in the sulphate aerosol scheme.
